english: An urn contains $3$ red balls and $3$ blue balls. Three balls are drawn from the urn one at a time at random. After each draw, a red ball drawn is put back into the urn, whereas a blue ball drawn is kept aside and not put back. Then the probability that exactly two of the three balls drawn are blue is ______.
hindi: एक कलश में $3$ लाल तथा $3$ नीली गेंदें हैं। कलश से एक-एक करके तीन गेंदें यादृच्छया निकाली जाती हैं। प्रत्येक निकाल के बाद, निकाली गई लाल गेंद को कलश में वापस रख दिया जाता है, जबकि निकाली गई नीली गेंद को अलग रख दिया जाता है और वापस नहीं रखा जाता। तब निकाली गई तीनों गेंदों में से ठीक दो के नीली होने की प्रायिकता ______ है।
solution: Red is drawn with replacement, blue without, so the urn changes only after a blue draw
solution_full: A red draw is with replacement (urn unchanged); a blue draw is without replacement (one blue fewer). So the urn composition before each draw depends on how many blue balls have been drawn so far: after $j$ blue draws it holds $3$ red and $3-j$ blue balls.
Exactly two blue balls means one of the orders $BBR$, $BRB$, $RBB$. By the multiplication theorem:
$BBR$: $\dfrac{3}{6}\cdot\dfrac{2}{5}\cdot\dfrac{3}{4}=\dfrac{18}{120}=\dfrac{3}{20}$ (after two blue draws the urn has $3$ red, $1$ blue).
$BRB$: $\dfrac{3}{6}\cdot\dfrac{3}{5}\cdot\dfrac{2}{5}=\dfrac{18}{150}=\dfrac{3}{25}$ (the red draw leaves the urn at $3$ red, $2$ blue).
The orders are mutually exclusive, so the probability is $\dfrac{3}{20}+\dfrac{3}{25}+\dfrac{1}{10}=0.15+0.12+0.10=0.37$.
originality_note: New: a mixed sampling rule (red with replacement, blue without), so the three orders of the same colour count have three different products (way 5: drawing with and without replacement in one process, linked by the multiplication theorem). Closest known: 'three balls drawn with replacement / without replacement, probability all same colour'. Different because: the replacement rule depends on the colour drawn, so the student cannot use a single binomial or hypergeometric formula.

concept_use.Drawing with and without replacement: Red balls are drawn with replacement and blue balls without, which fixes the urn before each draw.
concept_use.Multiplication theorem: Each order's probability is the product of the successive conditional draw probabilities (multiplication theorem).
